expr: (() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr, [role=row]')).find(r => r.textContent.includes('T4 portal-submitted')); if (!row) return 'NO-ROW'; const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => /cancel/i.test(b.textContent)); if (!btn) return 'NO-CANCEL-BTN in row: ' + row.textContent.slice(0,80); btn.click(); return 'clicked Cancel'; })()

(() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr, [role=row]')).find(r => r.textContent.includes('T4 portal-submitted')); return row ? 'AFTER: ' + row.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0, 120) : 'row gone'; })()
